script.problem: Its wrong detail "Bless our houses" isn't in the line word for word.
Its true detail "Depart from us" isn't in Job 22:17 word for word.

terra.problem: The verses say the strength of the fatherless was crushed, but do not explicitly say Job crushed it.
The verses do not explicitly say the wicked men were snatched away after they told God to depart.
The retelling omits the condition that Job consign his gold to the dust and the gold of Ophir to the stones of the ravines.
